ordinary_progress_or_repair: Continue admitted scope with the logical owner. Use existing state/reporting for routine progress; communicate mid-run when information changes an action or a timely decision, without duplicate notifications or LLM polling.
retired_schedules: Old fixed Astra/research rounds remain retired on future resume; preserve three existing Sol reporting cadences only within explicit resume scope.
evolution: Current model/effort mappings are revisable defaults, not a permanent capability hierarchy. Choose organization by task dependencies, quality and real cost; methods, skills, prompts and tools may be added, removed or replaced. Preserve current fallback scope, running owners, historical science, cumulative exposure and device/order budgets. Only material uncertain changes need bounded outcome comparison; no fixed three-arm or per-edit trial requirement.
